newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes up, but techs running out of steam.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes up, but techs running out of steam.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks managed to to continue to climb higher at the close for the fourth consecutive day on Friday, but analysts say that the high techs which have underpinned the market are running out of steam.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 2.07 points, or 0.17 percent, at 1230.05 at its unofficial close while gainers led losers by 2176 to 1890 on volume of about 561 million shares.
"The tech stocks need to correct. They came a little to far a little too fast. I see consolidation rather than liquidation, said Eugene Peroni, chief technical analyst with Janney Montgomery Scott.
The techs were mixed, with Microsoft Corp up 2-3/8 at 134-2/8, Intel Corp down 1/2 at 96-7/8.
U.S. Robotics Corp was down 3-3/4 at 69-1/4, Sun Microsystems Inc fell 1-3/4 to 63-1/4 and DSC Communications Corp fell 1-3/8 to 26.
Shares of popular removable storage drive maker Iomega Corp topped the Nasdaq most active list, rising 7/8 to 23-1/4 on volume of about 11 million shares.
